notes: property origin: base = ComponentModel base class (19 props); dll = server strong-typed (Epicor.MetaFX.Core.dll [ComponentModel]); designer = App Studio property panel (front-end consumed, server stores verbatim).
dll properties carry .NET type in "type"; designer editorType normalized to editorTypes names, unresolved webpack refs dropped; enum kept verbatim.
cfg-* types belong to the Configurator designer (separate UI), NOT App Studio layouts.
presence = production KNTCMetaUI files containing "sourceTypeId":"<id>" out of 25194 (time snapshot).

nodeShape.sourceTypeId: <component type id; MUST be a key of components>
nodeShape.components: <array of child Component nodes; universal tree slot>

layoutRules.universalChildSlot: children live in node.components (tree form) as full Component nodes

tabstrip.tabs: tab definitions in model.data[] items {id,title,page,selected,...}; tab content are child Component nodes

layoutRules.contentJsonWarning: contentJson must be the INNER layout node (component tree). NEVER pass a file envelope containing $schema/contentVersion/imports.
layoutRules.unknownTypeIdBehavior: server tolerates unknown sourceTypeId (stored via base model, front-end ignores it) - silent failure. Always pick typeIds from components keys; this file is the whitelist.

contentRules._comment: Rules for layer CONTENT blocks (GPEDev.Ice.UXAppVersion.Content), reverse-engineered from server decompiled code (MetaFXCore) and verified against real layer rows in DB. Content is NOT a full layer JSON: it is a per-block DIFF MANIFEST. Config here is read-only knowledge for constructing/parsing content blocks.

storageModel.topLevel: flat JSON object; each key is one content block: config / layout / <page name>... / events / rules / tools / dataviews

blockShape.Name: <block name, same as the key>
blockShape.Diffs: <array of diff entries; absent when empty>

diffEntryShape.Id: <component/entry id the diff applies to; null when block-level Add>
diffEntryShape.Path: '' + Add = insert whole entry (Value = full object); '/propName' = property-level patch on an existing entry; 'components' = insert/move target

storageModel.blockLevelAdd: creating a NEW page: block Operation=Add with a single diff entry {Id:null, Path:null, Value:<complete page object>, Operation:'Add', Index:0}; modifying an EXISTING page: block Operation=Replace with per-entry diffs

layout.meaning: Landing Page patch block (not a full page)

pages.meaning: one block per page, keyed by page name

events.storageShape: DICTIONARY keyed by event id (NOT an array). Events may also live standalone in a KNTCEventLayout layer (same dict shape).

entryShape.disable: NOTE: events use 'disable' while rules use 'disabled' (asymmetric)

actionExamples.condition: designer may leave residue field ~select_connector:'onSuccess' - ignore it

events.authoritativeSchema: Epicor.MetaFX.Core.Events.EventFiles/events.v5.0.json (server side) - trigger.type/hook enums, 70+ action types, ~100 definitions; trust it over this summary

entryShape.condition: <expression, e.g. Constant.CompanyID = 'GPEHK' | not Constant.CompanyID = 'GPEHK' | GPCompareResult.CustID like '%Total%' | TransView.isShowCustPart = true>

tools.patchShape: property-level diffs, e.g. {Path:'/disabled', Value:true} or {Path:'/mode', Value:'U'}

entryShape.mode: A | U | D (D = delete the view)

conventions.parentId: <panelCardId>#bodyComponents (flatten convention, see layoutRules.panelCardParentIdConvention); root panel-card parentId=null
conventions.orphans: moved-out components get Orphans_ prefixed id + originalParentId field (see layoutRules/orphans handling)
conventions.modeMarkers: rules/tools/dataviews entries carry their own mode (A/U/D); server stores them as-is via BaseMetadataType (no type validation)
conventions.eventLayer: standalone event layer: UXAppVersion TypeCode=KNTCEventLayout; custom layer content: TypeCode=KNTCCustLayer (Key1=layer, Key2=viewId, Key3=Desktop)
